title: BatchSpec
description: Sourcegull bulk change spec. Alternatives are expressed with type lists and if/then instead of oneOf so that validation errors point at the offending field.

version.description: Bulk change spec format version; 1 when omitted. Version 2 runs steps only in matched workspaces and skips repositories without changes.

name.description: Name of the bulk change, unique in its namespace: word characters, dots and dashes.

description.description: Free-form description of the bulk change.

on.description: Repositories (and branches) the steps run in: search queries and/or named repositories.

steps.description: Commands that produce the changes, run in order in each workspace.

transformChanges.description: Splits the changes of a repository into additional changesets.

importChangesets.description: Existing merge requests to track in the bulk change.

repositoriesMatchingQuery.description: Search query; the repository of every result is included.

repository.description: Repository name as known to Sourcegull.

branch.description: Branch to change instead of the default branch.

branches.description: Branches to change instead of the default branch.

rootAtLocationOf.description: File name whose directories become workspaces, e.g. package.json.

in.description: Glob of the repository names this configuration applies to.

onlyFetchWorkspace.description: Fetch only the workspace's files instead of the whole repository.

run.description: Shell script run in the container (template string).

container.description: Container image the script runs in.

env.description: Step environment: a map of names to values, or a list of NAME (passed through from the executor's secrets or the local environment) and {NAME: value} entries.

files.description: Files created in the container: path to content (template string).

outputs.description: Named outputs available to later steps and the changeset template as outputs.<name>.

if.description: Condition (boolean or template string); the step is skipped unless it evaluates to true.

mount.description: Local files or directories (relative to the bulk change spec) mounted into the container.

directory.description: Directory (relative to the repository root) whose changes form this group.

repository.description: Apply the group only in this repository.

externalIDs.description: Merge request numbers (IIDs) on the code host.

changesetTemplate.description: How changesets are created from the changes of each workspace. All strings are template strings.

fork.description: Push to a fork of the repository; overrides the site's enforceForks setting.

published.description: true, false, "draft", or a list of {repository glob: flag} where the last match wins. Omitted: publication is controlled from the UI.
